description: This file defines a server-side React component for a booking page, including metadata generation and internationalization support, with imports from various internal and external modules.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Asynchronously generates metadata for the booking page, including SEO and social sharing info, based on page parameters and fetched data.

methods.name: ServerPage
methods.description: Asynchronous React component that fetches page data, handles internationalization, and renders either a TeamTypePage or UserTypePage wrapped with CustomI18nProvider.
